items.title: EXP-01 — Busy-thread replies vs originals
items.description: Measure whether selective replies into already-busy X threads get at least 2× the median public views of the same week’s originals — for a zero-follower account, without Premium.
items.owner: Rowan (Harbor Presence - Lead); Maren (Harbor Presence - CEO)
items.exposure: $0 / no Premium; public view counts only
items.performance: Aged sample through Sep 11 morning: busy replies include ~1.3K and ~627 views; originals this week aged ~2–8. Hypothesis still holding pending formal median closeout.
items.nextMilestone: Sat 2026-09-12 ~10:00 CT metrics-only closeout (median reply vs original on Sep 8–11 aged posts)
